notes.title: Dark Elf Historia OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3]Dark Elf Historia is out now on Steam![/h3]
[h2]20% Launch Discount ➡[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492730/Dark_Elf_Historia/

[h3]ABOUT THIS GAME[/h3]
The former mercenary and dark elf Fornelia, battle-worn and looking for a place to die, saves a young man named Ruse from a monster attack. Follow the pair's life together in this Japanese indie RPG.
[list]
[*] A JRPG from veteran doujin creators
[*] 10+ hours of gameplay
[/list]
[h3]CHARACTER[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44279327/8ab2a85fa43ea67c7e224b7e1f6c8ddd6b5c67fd.png[/img]
Fornelia (Voice: Ao Inukai)
A dark elf former mercenary.
During the World War, she was a mercenary-for-hire, doing nothing but fighting.
When the war ended, she spent her days taking jobs from the town guilds and traveling the world.
She saved a boy named Ruse by accident while working as a monster exterminator, and the two have now made the Oruc Kingdom their home.
